changelog:
- Initial release of the runware-models skill.
- Enables dynamic selection and validation of Runware models based on up-to-date catalog lookup.
- Supports capability and modality-based catalog search; avoids hardcoding specific model IDs.
- Ensures chosen models are live, appropriate for the task, cost-effective, and quality-vetted.
- Acts as a foundation skill for downstream outcome skills to delegate model choice and avoid catalog drift.
